logbl.f80.diag: probe x86_fp80 (): cq controlled lowering: loop under quantum control
logbl.f80.scope_ref: DEFERRED 2026-08-21 by the owner GO on bd eyhj ('the others that cannot be compiled that way, such as ilogbl will be tackled later') — tracker bd ywws. NOT decided-decline: the 2026-07-28 parity ruling is NO LONGER the ground. New ground = 'no derivable bound exists', measured: CouldNotCompute on BOTH loops at every SCEV query under 12 pipelines and on the post-promoteFp80Union module, and that is CORRECT not conservative — on the rotated IR body 2 inputs (0, 0x80000000) never terminate. The only bound available is GUARD-CONDITIONAL on a TAINTED (manl|manh)!=0 guard that PredMux removes, so the SCOPING-L3 §6 item 1 recognizer that would recover it is a silent-miscompile shape (bd k02s). Safety today is an ACCIDENT of SCEV reporting nothing. NOT re-openable by a static-K unroll: LoopUnrollPrepass visits these loops and claims none, failing U3/U5/U6, and U6 demands the EXACT trip count (LoopUnrollPrepass.cpp:199) — raising kMaxUnrollTrip 8->33 changes NOTHING. bd ww4c's ctlz recognizer does not reach them either (the divergent inputs are exactly what is_zero_poison would have to exclude)

NOT a static-K unroll — see the ilogbl/logbl entry for why that mechanism is dead
